subject: Permission to cite SOC 2 and ISO attestation in BlueHarbor case study
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@blueharbor.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Chen <paul.chen@blueharbor.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: can we cite Redwood's SOC 2/ISO attestation in our case study?

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency improvements you showed have been a huge help for our real-time analytics pipeline. We're finalizing the case study draft and we'd like to include a short line referencing Redwood's security posture (specifically SOC 2 + ISO attestations) and possibly cite a public attestation.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide an "approved" security blurb we can include verbatim, and confirm a publicly accessible link to the attestation(s) we can reference? The marketing team also asked if Redwood is comfortable with this wording: "Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II certification and ISO 27001 attestation; see our public reports for details." If you need to redline, happy to accept a one-sentence alternative.

Attached is our current case study draft (BlueHarbor_case-study-draft.pdf) for context. We'd love to publish the case study next week and need approvals by EOD Monday if possible.

Thanks,
Sara
Product Marketing Manager
BlueHarbor Analytics

---
Attachment: BlueHarbor_case-study-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: can we cite Redwood's SOC 2/ISO attestation in our case study?

Hi Sara — really glad the demo was useful, and excited to see the draft.

Short answer: yes, we can provide a security blurb and a link to our public attestations. I'll need approval from security for final wording; looping in Laura and Monica from Security & Comms to coordinate wording and to confirm the correct public links.

Two small asks from our side:
- Would you prefer a short factual line (e.g., "Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations; public reports available at <link>") or a slightly stronger endorsement-style quote?
- Please confirm whether BlueHarbor needs us to sign any NDAs or legal approvals for the case study (your draft references customer metrics — if those are sensitive we should note that in the final copy).

I'll follow up once Laura confirms the approved blurb. For transparency, I'm attaching the internal request stub I send to Security (redwood_blurb_request.txt).

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: redwood_blurb_request.txt (text/plain)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: [SECURITY APPROVED] Approved blurb + public attestation links for BlueHarbor case study

Avery / Monica —

Approved security blurb for external publication (SOC 2 & ISO):

"Redwood Inference maintains an independent SOC 2 Type II examination and ISO 27001 attestation. Customers may reference our public control reports and attestations at: https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2-report-2025.pdf and https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/iso27001-attestation-2025.pdf."

Notes / constraints:
- This blurb is cleared for verbatim use in customer case studies and marketing collateral.
- No additional internal control detail should be published beyond the public reports linked above.
- If the customer requests inclusion of specific audit excerpts, security must review and approve those excerpts separately.

Attached: SOC2_summary_page.pdf (for customer context) — feel free to share the one-page summary with BlueHarbor.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: SOC2_summary_page.pdf (application/pdf, 245KB)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: can we cite Redwood's SOC 2/ISO attestation in our case study?

Hi Sara — thanks for the draft and the quick turnaround. Laura from Security has approved the following blurb you can include verbatim:

"Redwood Inference maintains an independent SOC 2 Type II examination and ISO 27001 attestation. Customers may reference our public control reports and attestations at: https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2-report-2025.pdf and https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/iso27001-attestation-2025.pdf."

I've attached the short blurb file (redwood_blurb_v1.txt) and the one-page SOC 2 summary for your reference. If you'd like a slightly stronger editorial quote (e.g., a one-sentence endorsement about our handling of customer data that reads like a testimonial), we can propose wording but will need explicit sign-off from Security first.

Also to confirm: Redwood does not require any extra NDA to be signed for the case study itself, but we will need final copy approval before publication per our standard process.

Would you like us to add the blurb directly into your draft and send the updated pdf? If so, send a pointer to the exact location and we'll drop it in.

Best regards,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: redwood_blurb_v1.txt (text/plain), SOC2_summary_page.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks for the quick responses and the approved blurb. BlueHarbor is happy to use the exact wording you provided; we made a very small editorial tweak for flow (replace "Customers may reference" with "See our public reports at"). The line we'll insert reads: "Redwood Inference maintains an independent SOC 2 Type II examination and ISO 27001 attestation. See our public reports at: https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2-report-2025.pdf and https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/iso27001-attestation-2025.pdf."
